title: Ten minutes in a Link session stay in phase in the browser
description:
As the owner, I want the same 10-minute measurement for the web app, so that the browser path is held to a number too.

Spec file: `features/link/phase.feature`; runner: `web/scripts/link-drift.mjs` (headless Chrome through Playwright, against `apricity serve --link`). Tolerance: browser, from `design/link.md` (proposal 10 ms, p99 and max).

```gherkin
Feature: Staying in phase with a Link session in the browser

  Scenario: Ten minutes in phase, in the browser
    Given the reference peer's script from "Ten minutes in phase, natively"
    And the web app plays the click score through apricity serve --link
    When 10 minutes have passed
    Then every click the page played is within the browser tolerance of the reference peer's beat
    And the report gives the maximum and p99 error, the clock offset's spread, and each re-warp's bar
```
